public.text: The note says the data requirements are illustrative, while the table marks many fields Mandatory. This creates uncertainty over whether conformance requires every field or merely support for the field.
public.suggestedRevision: Distinguish schema support, conditional record requirement, and mandatory presence. Define applicability and permitted absent-data reasons.
